record.paper_title: Separability of Topological Groups: A Survey with Open Problems
record.context_brief: free abelian quotients with countable networks
record.original_question: For every Lindelof space X and every infinite space Y with a countable network, does the free abelian topological group A(X) admit an open continuous homomorphism onto the free abelian topological group A(Y)?

evidence.quote: Does there exist an open continuous homomorphism of A(X) onto A(Y), where X is an arbitrary Lindelof space and Y is an infinite space which has a countable network?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a Tychonoff space $Z$, let $A(Z)$ denote the free abelian topological group over $Z$ in the sense of Markov; that is, $A(Z)$ is an abelian topological group containing $Z$ as a closed subspace such that $Z$ algebraically generates $A(Z)$ and every continuous map of $Z$ into an arbitrary abelian topological group $H$ extends to a unique continuous homomorphism $A(Z) \to H$. Recall that a family $\mathcal{N}$ of subsets of a space is a network if for every point $x$ and every neighborhood $U$ of $x$ there exists $N \in \mathcal{N}$ with $x \in N \subseteq U$; a space has a countable network if it admits such a family that is countable. A space is Lindelöf if every open cover has a countable subcover.

Question: Does it hold that for every Lindelöf (Tychonoff) space $X$ and every infinite (Tychonoff) space $Y$ with a countable network, there exists an open continuous surjective homomorphism $A(X) \to A(Y)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in a survey on separability of topological groups. Web search did not yield a published resolution; related literature treats separable quotients and network/tightness conditions on free (abelian) topological groups but does not settle the existence of such an open continuous homomorphism for arbitrary Lindelöf X and arbitrary infinite Y with a countable network.

status_evidence.title: Separable Quotients of Free Topological Groups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies separable quotients of free topological groups but does not establish a general open homomorphism A(X) onto A(Y) for Lindelöf X and Y with countable network.
status_evidence.claim: Related but does not resolve the problem.

status_evidence.title: Countable tightness and G-bases on free topological groups
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses topological properties of F(X) and A(X) for Tychonoff X; does not provide the requested open homomorphism construction.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution found in this line of work.
